name: Draw With Me
description: 152 step by step drawing lessons from simple to detailed, with a drawing of the day and a surprise pick.

about.concept: Decomposing a complex shape into simple strokes, in order. Each lesson shows one line at a time, so the child learns that a detailed picture is a sequence of small, repeatable moves.
about.progression: Lessons run from four-stroke animals to detailed scenes with shading. A drawing of the day and a surprise pick keep the child moving along the sequence rather than repeating a favorite.
lifeSkills: Breaking a big task into steps
Confidence to make something from nothing
